description: Complete backup-first instruction compression across agent/MCP/skill sources, local input/output compression with meaningful performance evidence, and safe repair/rebinding of the existing task session.

task_caveman_cli.description: Implement backup-first Caveman compression for discovered agent instructions and supported MCP/skill prompts; validate meaning before apply; compress local model inputs and outputs; measure paired latency/token savings; repair and rebind the existing task. Acceptance gates preserved here because the existing Agent OS contract has an empty acceptance_criteria list: (1) every changed instruction has a byte-identical verified backup and reversible restore; (2) meaning checks protect omissions, code, commands, URLs, headings, and policy requirements; (3) local input/output compression leaves structured/code payloads unchanged; (4) paired baseline/candidate measurements separate latency, tokens, and semantic results, with no regression claim; (5) existing task ID retained and canonical session binding verified, without direct task-store edits; (6) focused tests and integrated source validation pass, with plan and receipts aligned.
task_caveman_cli.next_action: Hotovo: Backup-first kompresni pipeline, semanticka kontrola a bezpecne obnoveni implementovany v caveman_instructions.py a CLI; runtime integrace v services.py aktivni; 19 unit testu v test_caveman_compression.py prosel.
